The Evans County Board of Commissioners has tentatively adopted a 2026 millage rate which will require an increase in property tax by 22.28 percent.

All concerned citizens are invited to the public hearing on the tax increase to be held at the Evans County Administrative Building located at 613 W. Main St, Claxton, Georgia on December 1, 2026 at 11:00 am and 5:30 pm.

Times and places of additional public hearings on this tax increase are at Evans County Administrative Building located at 613 W. Main St, Claxton, Georgia on December 10, 2026 at 6:00 pm

This tentative increase will result in a millage rate of 8.528 mills, an increase of 1.554 mills. Without this tentative increase, the millage rate will be no more than 6.974 mills. The proposed tax increase for a home with a fair market value of $100,000 is approximately $62.16 and the proposed tax increase for non-homestead property with a fair market value of $300,000 is approximately $186.47.
